method: Production-build Chrome browser conversion through the public worker and Wasm engine, followed by independent FFprobe and complete native FFmpeg decode. Native tools did not perform conversion. Disposable output copies were deleted by browser-test teardown.

focusedTest.command: WITHIN_TEST_VIDEO=off npx playwright test tests/browser/media-options.spec.ts --grep 'M-08 maps M4A tags across other advertised audio containers'

limitations: This is one 64,973-byte M4A source, not broad field-mapping or stress certification.
Ogg, Opus, and WMA additionally copied irrelevant M4A brand keys; destination-specific filtering remains open.

The later AIFF ID3v2/artwork candidate passed the small browser check but failed the 250 MiB complete-Chromium cold-run gate; see evidence/aiff-id3-memory-candidate-2026-09-20.json. It was not published.
